Thirty-nine years later, James Webb Space Telescope observations identified S/2025 U1, a moon about 10 kilometres wide between Ophelia and Bianca. The discovery raised the known number of Uranus moons to 29 and showed that small objects can remain hidden among the planets rings and inner satellites.
